verdict.rationale: Paperspace's machine-creation docs list a public IP address and a private network as features you can enable on a new machine, and shared drives are described as accessible from multiple machines in a private network. That covers the instance-to-instance connectivity half of the story and implies reachability for serving apps. However, nothing documents exposing specific ports, firewall rules or ingress configuration, or how private networks are set up and isolated. missing for 10: explicit port exposure/firewall documentation, details on private network configuration between instances, independent or hands-on corroboration.
